# Confirm mouse recovery also tells users their draft reopened

## What & Why
Keyboard recovery now announces that the saved draft was reopened, but the same user-visible outcome should stay covered when someone activates the recovery control with a pointer. This protects the shared recovery handler from future regressions.

## Done looks like
- Add browser coverage for pointer recovery of an answer draft and an opportunity draft.
- Assert the reopened-draft announcement for both recovery paths.
- Keep the existing expiry announcement assertions unchanged.

- artifacts/escape-hatch/tests/persistence.spec.ts
